"},{"span_id":"8745:1@U013","start":1158,"end":1222,"text":"Still, my father is not my sole relative following this career. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U014","start":1222,"end":1397,"text":"Several of my uncles have pursued this job choice, and my aunt who, even though her current job is that of a nurse, is currently studying to obtain her degree in engineering. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U015","start":1397,"end":1539,"text":"Adding to this, I am also surrounded by non-relatives who have jobs as engineers, since I live in a city with multiple engineering companies. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U016","start":1539,"end":1685,"text":"This shows that I have been exposed to engineering in several ways, which has given me an insight of what to expect while studying for the role.

"},{"span_id":"8745:1@U018","start":1777,"end":1858,"text":"Many would see this as a negative aspect of becoming an engineer; yet, I do not. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U020","start":1926,"end":2015,"text":"It would fascinate me how much critical thinking and solving-problem skills it required. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U024","start":2375,"end":2457,"text":"It is this kind of dedication and hard work that has led me to where I am today.

"},{"span_id":"8745:1@U026","start":2593,"end":2728,"text":"There are not many women that choose engineering as their first career choice, yet I, a woman, am studying and aiming for engineering. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U033","start":3269,"end":3343,"text":"Knowing this, I decided to take part in Spanish and French Honor Society.
